# Marked

Vendored Marked **16.4.2**, copied without modification from the published
`lib/marked.esm.js` distribution (renamed `marked.mjs`). MIT license included.

Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v16.4.2

Bundled so artifact previews need no package installation or network access.
The preview renderer disables raw HTML and restricts link and image URLs;
Marked itself does not sanitize HTML.
